items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: I didn't know Danny at all. They told me I've been here and talked of him, but he always is away all these days.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, but you didn't hear him in the old days?
No, no, no. I didn't know him in the old days. I didn't know Danny at all. They told me I've been here and talked of him, but he always is away all these days. Yeah, he never was in the city.
That's about the end of this tape.
